name: Document - Archive Old Documents

parameters.query: UPDATE doc_documents SET status = 'ARCHIVED', archived_at = NOW() WHERE status = 'CLOSED' AND created_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '2 years' AND archived_at IS NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL RETURNING COUNT(*) as archived_count, tenant_id;
SELECT channel_id FROM doc_config WHERE tenant_id = $1;
